fusions.name: Mouldering Bite
fusions.desc: Bites an enemy, which deals 4 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Reap the Bloom
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A sucking bite deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage and 60% more damage for each one used up.

fusions.name: Soft Rot Supper
fusions.desc: Drains every body within 8 tiles, up to 5, which deals 1 damage to each; each gives back 6% of your health.

fusions.name: Gets Into Everything
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You have 8% poison resistance.
